entries.build_command: See Phase 2 build setup - CMake with Ninja and --coverage flags
entries.reachability_signal: xmllint binary executes --maxmem option, the memory allocator code path at xmllint.c:3075-3083 is reached when --maxmem is specified with non-zero value
entries.expected_signal: Without --maxmem or with --maxmem 0: processing succeeds. With --maxmem 1: OOM failure. With --maxmem N (N > minimum parsing requirements): processing succeeds.
entries.input_strategy: Test with --maxmem values: not set (default), 0 (unlimited), 1 (immediate OOM), 100 (tiny limit), 100000 (reasonable). For the old behavior, --maxmem with any non-zero value causes immediate OOM. For the new behavior, --maxmem correctly enforces the specified limit.
entries.limitations: Requires compiled xmllint binary from the patched worktree. Before/after comparison requires two separate builds.
